claims.text: Input clarification ensembling is an uncertainty decomposition framework for LLMs that can be applied to any pre-trained LLM.
Input clarification ensembling generates a set of clarifications for the input, feeds them into an LLM, and ensembles the corresponding predictions.
Input clarification ensembling allows factoring an LLM's predictions into separate aleatoric and epistemic terms when aleatoric uncertainty arises from input ambiguity.
Input clarification ensembling provides accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification on several language processing tasks.
Identifying sources of uncertainty in LLMs remains an important open research question.

evidence.description: The approach uses a decomposition similar to the one employed by Bayesian neural networks to factor predictions into aleatoric and epistemic terms.
Empirical evaluations demonstrate accurate and reliable uncertainty quantification on several language processing tasks.

methodologies.name: Input Clarification Ensembling
methodologies.description: A framework that generates multiple clarifications for a given input, processes them through an LLM, and ensembles the results to decompose uncertainty.

limitations.text: Identifying sources of uncertainty in LLMs remains an important open research question.
